system.description:
Some horrible end awaits you, and you cannot avert it; worse, you have foreknowledge of your demise or eternal torment. The Storyteller sets a particular fate that will inevitably strike and remove your character from play.

In any session the Storyteller deems appropriate, you may receive a vision of your coming misery; you must spend a Willpower Trait to shake it off, or you are one Trait down on all challenges for the rest of the session.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
